title: What follows a jam?
hook: A box can open—or resist. Choose the next request.

knows: a tool request is distinct from execution
doesNotKnow: how an observation changes the next requested action
how a finite scripted controller stops

misconception: An agent is only a more capable model or a single tool call.
objective: Trace an observation-dependent observe/action loop, including its jam branch and terminal stop.

claims.text: The jammed trace is closed → open, jammed → help, help requested → stop; no read action occurs.
claims.source: Independent derivation and source audit: company/reviews/agent-loop/2026-10-19-fact-all-ai-foundations.md; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2210.03629 (section 2, PDF p.3, lines 286–303); src/demos/ai/agent-loop/model.ts and Demo.tsx. Registered recall verified separately; shared footer coverage gap remains.

claims.text: The unjammed trace is closed → open, open → read, ticket 6 → stop. The finite scripted controller branches on observations and does not learn or call a live model.
claims.source: Independent derivation and source audit: company/reviews/agent-loop/2026-10-19-fact-all-ai-foundations.md; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2210.03629 (section 2, PDF p.3, lines 286–303); src/demos/ai/agent-loop/model.ts and Demo.tsx. claims.text: Follow the rule for the observation, rather than an earlier planned action.

recall.question: A changed controller sees a locked door and has the rule locked → ask for key. What comes next?
options: Stop because all loops stop immediately
recall.why: Follow the rule for the observation, rather than an earlier planned action.
